picks.analysis: The Panthers have a strong roster and should dominate the line of scrimmage. Arizona's defense may struggle to contain their running game.
Both teams have explosive offensive capabilities that can lead to a high-scoring game. Expect both quarterbacks to take advantage of the preseason defenses.
The Cardinals, playing at home, could pull off an upset with their talented receiving corps. Carolina may not field their starters for long, giving Arizona an edge.
